milestone.title: post-M229 raul TUI Watch lane collapse — remove tui::watch duplicate state and Watch* actions

intent.outcome: After M229's mp-side removal, the raul TUI exposes a single Autopilot lane with no duplicate Watch state, no Watch-prefixed Action variants, and no tui::watch module; users who press the same keymap as today reach the same outcome.

problem.description: M228 renamed canonical autopilot internals in crates/mp/ but the raul TUI still carries both lanes: App::watch (crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs:696) holds a `Watch` model alongside App::autopilot, and crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs (1465 lines) duplicates types, parser, and preflight/start/stop handlers that route through `mp watch`. Action::WatchStart, Action::WatchStop, Action::WatchRefresh, Action::WatchPreflight, Action::WatchToggleSelect, Action::WatchMovePicker, Action::WatchMoveQueue, Action::WatchClearQueue (crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs:241-266) all dispatch to that module. M229 removed the mp watch alias and the watch-control subcommands, so the raul side now points at nothing — the Watch lane renders, parses, and shells out to commands that no longer exist. Leaving this dead module in tree makes fixes to the live autopilot lane riskier (two source-of-truth surfaces for the same workflow) and confuses adopters who diff raul releases.

in_scope: Delete crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs and remove its pub mod entry in crates/raul/src/tui/mod.rs.
Remove Action::Watch* variants from crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs:241-266, 488, 849-880, 1820 and any dependent Rust flow that names them.
Remove App::watch (and Watch::empty() initializer) from crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs:696,835 and any render/polling path that reads it.
Re-route the keybinds/keymap (and migrate the legacy keybind source if any references survive) so Watch-prefixed actions map to the equivalent Autopilot action without breaking the user-visible flow.
Update the top-tab nav (crates/raul/src/tui/dashboard.rs), the autopilot lane picker, and any text/help surface that still says 'Watch' instead of 'Autopilot' where it would otherwise mislead.
Wire the migration diagnostic so users with a stale Watch keybind config get a one-shot on-screen hint pointing to the Autopilot lane and the new keybind.
Regenerate consumer-surface golden scenarios / install fixtures that reference the Watch lane or its labels.
out_of_scope: Changing the Autopilot lane (tui/autopilot.rs) surface or its keybind policy.
Changing the mp autopilot CLI commands, state shapes, or migration shims — that is owned by M229.
Removing historical changelog entries or archived milestone files.

acceptance_criteria.description: No tui::watch module exists after this ships: `crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs` is gone, `pub mod watch;` is gone from `crates/raul/src/tui/mod.rs`, and no source file in `crates/raul/src/` references `tui::watch::` or `crate::tui::watch::`.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test ! -e crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs && ! rg -n 'pub mod watch|::watch::|tui::watch' crates/raul/src/ (exit 0 with no matches).

acceptance_criteria.description: App state holds no Watch field: `App::watch` is removed and the only autopilot-related lane state lives under `App::autopilot`.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -n 'pub watch:' crates/raul/src/ (must return nothing); rg -n 'watch:\s*Watch::empty|watch:\s*Watch\b' crates/raul/src/ (must return nothing).

acceptance_criteria.description: Action enum carries no `Watch*` variant; the only autopilot-related actions are the Autopilot* variants.
acceptance_criteria.verification: rg -n 'Action::Watch' crates/raul/src/ (must return nothing); rg -n '\bWatch(Start|Stop|Refresh|Preflight|ToggleSelect|MovePicker|MoveQueue|ClearQueue)\b' crates/raul/src/ (must return nothing).

acceptance_criteria.description: Existing keybinds that pointed at Watch* actions still reach the equivalent Autopilot behavior (no UX regression for users with cached keybind configs from before M229).
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/keybinds/)' && cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/autopilot_lane/)'.

acceptance_criteria.description: The migration diagnostic surfaces a one-shot on-screen hint when the loaded keybind config still names a Watch-prefixed action, naming the Autopilot lane and the replacement keybind.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/watch_to_autopilot_migration/)' (new test in crates/raul/tests/tui_keybinds_migration.rs).

acceptance_criteria.description: Full mp + raul test suite plus consumer-surface lint pass with no behavior change on autopilot lane UX or JSON shape.

work_packages.name: Watch lane deletion
work_packages.goal: Remove every Watch-prefixed surface in raul so a single Autopilot lane owns the workflow
work_packages.rollback: Restore tui/watch.rs and the Watch action variants; the canonical Autopilot behavior is unchanged so the rollback is purely additive

work_packages.name: Keybind migration + diagnostics
work_packages.goal: Preserve user-visible behavior: prior Watch keybinds now drive the equivalent Autopilot action, and stale configs surface a one-shot migration hint
work_packages.rollback: Re-enable Watch-prefixed keybinds behind a config flag so historical installs keep working until the next session

steps.action: Delete crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs and the pub mod entry in tui/mod.rs; canonicalize whatever the module re-exported under tui::autopilot.
steps.tests: test ! -e crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs && ! rg -n 'pub mod watch' crates/raul/src/tui/mod.rs

steps.action: Remove Watch* Action variants from tui/action.rs:241-266,488,849-880,1820 and every reference in helper dispatches.
Remove the App::watch field and any Watch::empty() initializer; tui::app.rs:696,835.
Update render/watch.rs, runner_helpers.rs, poll.rs, dashboard.rs and any other code that referenced the Watch module — drop those branches and ensure they no longer compile against tui::watch.
steps.done_when: AC-01 + AC-02 source-pins pass and cargo check -p raul is clean

steps.action: Re-route the keybinds/keymap so any historical Watch-prefixed keybind source maps to the equivalent Autopilot action; preserve the user-visible flow.
Run the full test suite plus consumer-surface-lint; ensure no behavior change on autopilot lane UX or JSON shape; record the CHANGELOG entry.
Add a one-shot on-screen migration hint that surfaces when the loaded keybind config still names a Watch-prefixed action, naming the Autopilot lane plus the replacement keybind.
